UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Beginner yoga practitioner profile, preferences, streak metrics, and Watch H9 pairing state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

watchH9PairedName.description: Paired Watch H9 Bluetooth device name.

watchH9MacAddress.description: Paired Watch H9 BLE MAC address.

lastRestingHr.description: Most recent Watch H9 resting/current heart rate BPM.

lastWatchBattery.description: Most recent Watch H9 battery percentage.

lastWatchSyncEpochMs.description: Epoch millis of latest Watch H9 sync.

YogaRoutine.title: YogaRoutine
YogaRoutine.description: Personalized or saved beginner yoga sequence with target Watch H9 heart rate range.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

focusArea.description: Target area such as Back & Posture or Morning Mobility.

targetHrMin.description: Lower bound of Watch H9 target heart rate BPM.

targetHrMax.description: Upper bound of Watch H9 target heart rate BPM.

isAiGenerated.description: True if generated via Firebase AI Logic.

isFavorite.description: True if starred by the user.

poses.description: Ordered list of beginner yoga pose steps.

YogaSessionLog.title: YogaSessionLog
YogaSessionLog.description: Completed yoga practice record with optional Watch H9 biometric summary.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

avgHeartRate.description: Average Watch H9 heart rate BPM during session.

peakHeartRate.description: Peak Watch H9 heart rate BPM during session.

syncedFromWatchH9.description: True if Watch H9 supplied live telemetry.

WatchSyncRecord.title: WatchSyncRecord
WatchSyncRecord.description: Biometric snapshot synced from the user's Watch H9 device.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

deviceAddress.description: Watch H9 BLE address or identifier.

source.description: Origin of the Watch H9 telemetry.

/users/{userId}.description: User beginner yoga profile and Watch H9 pairing summary.

/users/{userId}/routines/{routineId}.description: User's personalized and saved beginner yoga routines.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User's completed beginner yoga session logs.

/users/{userId}/watch_syncs/{syncId}.description: Watch H9 telemetry snapshots synced by the user.
